proposals.rationale: Single jack reservation with reserved equal to sum. Concurrent double release should be idempotent with one success; if both delete and both decrement reserved it double-subtracts to negative and sum mismatch.
Jack plus unrelated holder alice with consistent reserved=sum. Exposes sum-vs-counter mismatch while checking non-target row is untouched when both actors release jack.

Two separate rows for same holder jack with reserved=sum. Exposes ambiguity in release_seats row selection: actors may delete same row twice or different rows, causing lost delete, double decrement, or leftover duplicate.
Full event where capacity equals reserved with only jack holding seats. Double release underflows reserved far below zero and breaks reserved-equals-sum and reserved-bounds invariants.
